test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"eulogised". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Eulogised" **means to praise or extol someone or something highly. 
 
• The word is derived from the Greek word **"eulogia", **meaning **"praise".**
 
 
• **Example: **The actor was eulogised for his outstanding performance in the film.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"sharpened", **means to make something sharp or honed. 

 
 
• **Example: **The chef **sharpened **his knives before starting to cook.
 
 
 
• Option 2, **"cemented", **means to bind or join together firmly, often with cement or glue.
 
 
• **Example: **The bricks were **cemented **together to create a sturdy wall.
 
 
 
• Option 3, **"sacrificed", **means to give up something valuable or important for a greater cause or purpose.
 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers **sacrificed **their lives to protect their country.
